tools.name: list_upcoming_unlocks
tools.description: List dated token unlock events from the Tokenomics Audit Desk 90-day unlock calendar, starting today (UTC), soonest first. Only events the desk holds verified figures for are included.

tools.name: get_token_unlocks
tools.description: Return every unlock event in the calendar for one token, matched case-insensitively against the token symbol (e.g. ENA, ZRO) or the project name (e.g. Ethena, LayerZero).

tools.name: get_unlock_calendar
tools.description: Return all unlock events whose date falls inside an inclusive ISO date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit a bound to leave that side open.

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Provenance and coverage of the unlock dataset behind this server: version, coverage window, entry count, sources, license (MIT) and attribution.
